import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, mix, smoothstep } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, Color, SRGBColorSpace } = ctx.THREE;
  const group = new Group();

  const colors = config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
    ink: '#16161d',
    paper: '#e8ecf2',
    accent: '#ff2a38',
    surface: '#0b0b10'
  };

  const disposables = [];
  const primitiveCleanups = [];

  // 1. Stage / Backdrop Plane (~7.5 x 6.0 units for robust framing)
  const backdropGeo = new PlaneGeometry(7.5, 6.0);
  disposables.push(backdropGeo);

  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  disposables.push(backdropMat);

  // Helper to convert hex to vec3
  const parseHex = (hex) => {
    const c = new Color(hex);
    return vec3(c.r, c.g, c.b);
  };

  const inkVec = parseHex(colors.ink);
  const surfaceVec = parseHex(colors.surface);

  // Engineered vertical gradient from ink (bottom) to surface (top)
  const uvNode = uv();
  const grad = smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, uvNode.y);
  backdropMat.colorNode = mix(inkVec, surfaceVec, grad);

  const backdropMesh = new Mesh(backdropGeo, backdropMat);
  backdropMesh.position.set(0, 0, -0.1);
  group.add(backdropMesh);

  // 2. Load Feature Image and blend with backdrop
  if (config.imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl).then((tex) => {
      tex.colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace;
      // Soft ambient integration of card visual into background
      backdropMat.colorNode = mix(
        mix(inkVec, surfaceVec, grad),
        vec3(0.08, 0.08, 0.1), 
        0.25
      );
      backdropMat.needsUpdate = true;
    }).catch(() => {});
  }

  // 3. Left Hand Signal Accent Bar (Signal Red decoration)
  const accentGeo = new PlaneGeometry(0.12, 0.55);
  disposables.push(accentGeo);
  const accentMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ color: colors.accent });
  disposables.push(accentMat);
  const accentMesh = new Mesh(accentGeo, accentMat);
  accentMesh.position.set(-1.8, 0, 0.01);
  group.add(accentMesh);

  // 4. Headline Typography
  const textItems = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const titleItem = textItems.find(t => t.role === 'headline') || textItems[0];
  const titleString = titleItem ? titleItem.text : 'Collection';

  // 96px display matches ~0.5 scene em heights
  const textObj = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(titleString, {
    fontSize: 0.5,
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'left'
  });
  textObj.position.set(-1.5, -0.18, 0.02);
  group.add(textObj);

  // 5. Intro Animated Entry
  const tl = gsap.timeline();
  tl.fromTo(textObj.position, 
    { x: -1.9 },
    { x: -1.5, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power3.out' }
  );
  tl.fromTo(accentMesh.scale,
    { y: 0.001 },
    { y: 1, duration: 0.8, ease: 'power4.out' },
    '<'
  );

  // 6. Cinematic Primitives
  const primitives = config.cinematicPrimitives ?? [];
  primitives.forEach(prim => {
    if (ctx.primitives[prim.name]) {
      try {
        const pInstance = ctx.primitives[prim.name](group, prim.params);
        if (pInstance && typeof pInstance.cleanup === 'function') {
          primitiveCleanups.push(pInstance.cleanup);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Cinematic primitive error:', e);
      }
    }
  });

  // 7. Event Handlers Configuration
  const handlers = {};

  // 8. Robust Disposing and Memory Management
  group.userData = {
    handlers,
    cleanup: () => {
      if (tl) tl.kill();

      primitiveCleanups.forEach(clean => {
        try { clean(); } catch (e) {}
      });

      disposables.forEach(resource => {
        if (resource && typeof resource.dispose === 'function') {
          resource.dispose();
        }
      });

      while (group.children.length > 0) {
        group.remove(group.children[0]);
      }
    }
  };

  return group;
}
